concept: Calming clinical-wellness palette for McCoy Chiropractic: a healing teal/blue-green primary grounded by deep slate ink on soft, clean off-white surfaces, lifted by a warm coral accent. The result reads trustworthy, calm, and caring with a clean clinical feel.
contrastNotes: All ratios computed against --color-bg (#F7FAFA). ink #1B2A30 on bg = 14.1:1 (>=7 PASS). ink-soft #4A5A60 on bg = 6.85:1 (>=4.5 PASS). white #FFFFFF on primary #0E7C86 = 4.95:1 (>=4.5 PASS). primary #0E7C86 on bg = 4.71:1 (>=3 PASS). primary-dark #0A5C64 gives white >=6:1 for hover/active states. Coral accent #E76F51 reserved for small accents/CTAs; pair with ink or white text on solid coral for AA at large sizes.
